overview_description.description: Ultrasonium develops metal additive manufacturing equipment and processes for aerospace, defense, and energy applications. Its platform includes electronic systems, embedded controls, robotics, mechanical assemblies, and process-monitoring capabilities for metal 3D printing. The company also develops multiphysics models and simulation workflows to guide equipment design and process validation.
